scope: The root exports the real eight-step kernel memcpy prefix and both actual repeated LDPs on the same reached machine. SmallPrefix consumes one original Code/count16/error/PC and derives all eight actual steps, complete frame and first-LDP fetch at origin+36. Actual checked native reads retain arbitrary byte contents, computed initialization and complete physical frames. The two real LDP instructions support both split ordered8byte and single16byte modes. One original16byte readable-range premise derives all native read outcomes, intermediate states/errors and exact Reference events under wrapping64. TwoLoads stores actual loaded/final witnesses constrained by both true steps; the first frame derives the second signed-minus16 base, current profile/code/error/PC and fetch. Repeated Reference event lists coincide, with complete memory/profile/program/monitor/atomic/thread/extra and other-register frame. Final PC=origin+44 derives the real first-STP fetch. The continuation consumes the SAME original eight-step prefix witness plus the equality identifying its reached state and invokes this two-load proof once from original profile/permission inputs. Actual loaded word observations, two repeated STPs, RET/LR, BTI/platform alternatives and complete helper/source/global/universal domains/recount continue before M6.
